description: Angular component for manufacturing equipment monitoring dashboard, handling alerts, real-time updates, and UI interactions.

classes.name: AppComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component managing alerts, KPIs, and UI interactions for manufacturing monitoring.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, loads alerts, subscribes to real-time alerts.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: trackByIndex
methods.description: Provides trackBy function for list rendering.

methods.name: badgeClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on alert priority.

methods.name: priorityIcon
methods.description: Returns icon glyph based on alert priority.

methods.name: typeIcon
methods.description: Returns icon for alert parameter type.

methods.name: dismissToast
methods.description: Removes a toast notification by ID.

methods.name: loadInitialAlerts
methods.description: Loads initial alerts via REST API.

methods.name: recomputeKpis
methods.description: Recalculates KPI metrics based on current alerts.

methods.name: pushToastForNewAlert
methods.description: Creates and displays a toast notification for a new alert.

methods.name: mapStoredAlert
methods.description: Maps API alert DTO to internal alert format.

methods.name: mapRealtimeAlert
methods.description: Maps real-time alert payload to internal alert format.

methods.name: alertKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for an alert to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: dedupAndSortNewestFirst
methods.description: Removes duplicate alerts and sorts by newest first.
